title: Karachi Session Of INC
definition: The 1931 Karachi Session of the Indian National Congress was a landmark event held under the presidency of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, primarily convened to endorse the Gandhi-Irwin Pact and define the socio-economic vision of independent India.
importanceInUpsc: It is a high-yield topic for UPSC Prelims (Resolution on Fundamental Rights) and Mains (Evolution of Congress ideology from political to socio-economic freedom).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Karachi Session Of INC.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
